name: Spotify
summary: You can register an app quickly, but without extended quota only 5 allowlisted users can use it. Extended quota is limited to established organizations with at least 250k monthly active users, so most new products can't launch publicly.
biggestRisk: Two non-technical limits could stop you: the 250k user threshold, and a policy against ingesting Spotify Content into AI models.

paths.name: Development mode, up to 5 users
paths.whenToUse: A personal tool, prototype or demo for people you can list by name.

wait.note: No approval step on this path.

steps.title: Register the app
steps.detail: In the Developer Dashboard, create an app and add the redirect URI from your Composio auth config. The app owner needs Spotify Premium.
steps.confirm: The app page shows a client ID.
steps.handoffReason: This requires your Spotify account and accepting the developer terms.

steps.title: Allowlist your users
steps.detail: Add each person to the app's allowlist before they connect.
steps.confirm: That user can connect and make an API call.
steps.handoffReason: This needs each user's account details.

blockers.cause: Requests from users who aren't allowlisted receive a 403.
blockers.action: Add them to the allowlist. If you've hit 5 users, you've reached the limit of this path.

paths.name: Extended quota, public launch
paths.whenToUse: An established company with a launched service and at least 250k monthly active users.

wait.note: Spotify says the review can take up to six weeks. That's after your partner application is approved, and we found no timing for that application.

steps.title: Check your eligibility first
steps.detail: Compare your company against each criterion: registered business, launched service, 250k monthly active users, key markets and commercial viability. If you miss one, stop here.
steps.confirm: You meet every criterion and have the numbers to show it.

steps.title: Check that your agent's use is allowed
steps.detail: Compare your agent's behavior against Spotify's Developer Policy, especially the rules on AI and machine learning.
steps.confirm: You can explain how the agent complies with each relevant rule.

steps.title: Apply as a partner
steps.detail: Submit the partner application from a company email address.
steps.handoffReason: This is a business application made by your company.

steps.title: Request the quota extension
steps.detail: In the Developer Dashboard, open Quota extension Request and complete the questionnaire.
steps.confirm: The dashboard shows your request as submitted.

steps.title: Wait for review
steps.detail: Spotify tests the app against its Developer Policy and replies by email.
steps.confirm: Spotify confirms by email and your app can serve users who aren't allowlisted.

blockers.symptom: You don't have 250k monthly active users
blockers.cause: Spotify requires this minimum for extended quota.
blockers.action: We found no alternative route. Keep Spotify features in a 5-user pilot, or design your product so it doesn't depend on them.

nuances.title: Your agent may conflict with the AI rule
nuances.detail: Spotify's policy bans ingesting Spotify Content into an AI model. Passing track data to a language model could fall under that, on any path. Get this answered before you build, ideally by asking Spotify.

nuances.title: Individuals can't apply
nuances.detail: Since May 15, 2025, Spotify only accepts extended quota applications from organizations.

nuances.title: Composio can't shortcut this
nuances.detail: Spotify is listed as bring-your-own, so you'd register the app and be subject to these limits yourself.

nuances.title: Spotify publishes OAuth metadata
nuances.detail: OIDC discovery responded at the standard path, so endpoints can be read from it.
